column1: # Kegare, a demon from another age who has taken Mia's visage.

column3:
I'm a demon from
another world.
Yet you know this face.{page_break}People see Mia
and think they're safe.
That's all I need.{end_wait}
Mia is standing\nright beside me.\nWho are you?{end_wait}

Kegare.
I watched her tend
to the sick in Imil.{page_break}They heard her voice
and let her close.
They'll let me close, too.{end_wait}
That's enough.\nYou won't use her face\nto hurt anyone.{end_wait}

You saw their fear.
You saw how long
I stayed with them.{page_break}Did you understand
why I stayed?{end_wait}

I know what they need.
A soft voice.
A familiar face.{page_break}They won't know
which of us is real.
Why aren't you afraid?{end_wait}

I am afraid.
For anyone who
mistakes you for me.{page_break}You may borrow my face.
You cannot borrow
what I chose to do.{end_wait}

This face won't hold.
It was never mine.
It never will be.{page_break}Others like me
will wear it after.
You can't watch every door.{end_wait}
Then I'll watch\nthe ones I can.\nThat is enough for me.{end_wait}
